title: Bills of Lading and Transport Documents: Issuing a Corrected Set of Originals
content:
On the paper types of the `Bills of Lading and Transport Documents` range that take their originals back for post-issue corrections, a corrected document circulates under a new set of originals, called the corrected set. This page defines that set and describes the agent tool that records it.

## What the corrected set is

The corrected set is the next set of the same document, numbered one above the set it replaces. It bears no issuance fee. Its originals are put into circulation, and once it is recorded the document shows the new set number, a new date of issue and the originals outstanding.

## A complete documentary package

A corrected set is issued only as a complete documentary package. Completeness means that, at the moment of issue, the documentation account of the document holds the correction fee owed on the correction request that the set carries. Where the carried correction arose from the line's own keying error, a correction the line never charges, nothing is owed on it and the account is complete with no fee entry at all.

## Invoking `issue_corrected_set_a7062696`

The tool is operated by the agent: unlock it through `unlock_agent_discoverable_tool`, then execute it through `call_agent_discoverable_tool`. One execution makes the set given the set in force on the document, dates its issue on the day of execution, adds the given number of originals to the originals in circulation and enters those originals in the documentation history as put into circulation. It books no issuance fee.

### Parameters

| Parameter | Content | How it is written |
|---|---|---|
| `bl_id` | Reference of the transport document being reissued as a corrected set, as the transport document lookup returns it | Identifier text |
| `request_id` | The correction request that the corrected set carries; its reference is the one listed by the documentation service request lookup | Identifier text |
| `bl_set_sequence` | Number of the new set of originals | Whole number with no decimals; 1 means the first set issued, 2 a replacement or switch set |
| `originals_count` | How many originals of the new set are put into circulation | Whole number, 0 or more, no decimals, in original documents |

### Return

When it succeeds, the tool returns one confirmation sentence naming the documentation entry for the originals put into circulation (an opaque reference beginning "boi_"), the transport document reference, the correction request carried, the new set number, the number of originals issued and the originals now outstanding. The sentence itself is the success signal.

## Basis Q&A

**Is an issuance fee charged on the corrected set?** No. The corrected set carries no issuance fee.

**If a document in its first set is reissued after such a correction, what set number does the new set take?** Set 2, one higher than the set it replaces.
